## Describe the bug

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. See error

## Expected behavior

What did you expect to happen?

## Actual behavior

What actually happened? Include exact error messages if any.

## Screenshots / screen recording

If applicable, add screenshots or a short recording to help explain the problem.

## Environment

- **GamaLab version**: (e.g. 1.0.0 — see About dialog)
- **Operating system**: (e.g. Windows 11 26200, macOS 14.3, Ubuntu 24.04)
- **Installation method**: (Store / installer .exe / built from source)
- **PostgreSQL version**: (e.g. 16.2)
- **Docker version**, if relevant: (e.g. 27.3.1)

## Feature affected

- [ ] Connection management
- [ ] SQL editor (tabs, autocomplete, formatting)
- [ ] AI SQL Assistant
- [ ] Docker integration
- [ ] CSV import / export
- [ ] Saved queries
- [ ] Schema explorer
- [ ] Result grid
- [ ] Settings / preferences
- [ ] Other:

## Additional context

Anything else that might be relevant — logs from DevTools (`Ctrl+Shift+I` in dev mode), main-process console output, recent changes to your workflow, etc.

## Confirmations

- [ ] I searched existing issues to make sure this hasn't been reported already
- [ ] I'm on the latest GamaLab release (or the current `main` if built from source)
